import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    n = int(input_data[0].strip())
    s = input_data[1].strip() if len(input_data) > 1 else ""
    
    sequence = list(s)
    
    longestOutside = 0
    longestInside = 0
    currentLength = 0
    insideParentheses = False
    
    for index in range(len(sequence)):
        currentChar = sequence[index]
        
        if currentChar == '(':
            if currentLength > 0:
                longestOutside = max(longestOutside, currentLength)
            currentLength = 0
            insideParentheses = True
        elif currentChar == ')':
            if currentLength > 0:
                longestInside += 1
            currentLength = 0
            insideParentheses = False
        elif currentChar == '_':
            if insideParentheses:
                if currentLength > 0:
                    longestInside += 1
                currentLength = 0
            else:
                if currentLength > 0:
                    longestOutside = max(longestOutside, currentLength)
                currentLength = 0
        else:
            currentLength += 1
    
    if currentLength > 0:
        longestOutside = max(longestOutside, currentLength)
    
    print(f"{longestOutside} {longestInside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
